verdict.rationale: Fin explicitly supports taking real actions ('Takes action to update external systems', Fin Procedures/Tasks docs) and exposes an Agent API, webhooks, and OAuth-gated MCP server confirmed live at runtime, but there is no concrete documentation of per-action scoped authorization (e.g., separate auth scopes for refunds vs. order changes vs. subscription updates) or a worked example of such actions. Missing for 10: explicit per-action auth-scoping documentation, and a concrete example/case study of Fin executing refund/order/subscription actions through scoped credentials.
